evals.name: validate-good-code
evals.prompt: Validate the Astro project at template/astro-project/. Run astro check, typecheck, and build. Output validation-report.json.
evals.expected_output: validation-report.json showing all files passed with no violations. All checks (astro check, typecheck, build) should pass.

evals.name: fix-missing-layout-import
evals.prompt: Validate and fix this broken page: src/pages/index.astro exists but doesn't import Layout. Check the file, identify the error, and apply the auto-fix.
evals.expected_output: The error is identified (missing Layout import), the fix is applied (adding import Layout from '@/layouts/Layout.astro'), and the file now includes the import.

evals.name: fix-arbitrary-color
evals.prompt: Validate and fix this file with arbitrary Tailwind color: src/pages/index.astro contains class='bg-[#3b82f6]'. Identify and fix the error.
evals.expected_output: The arbitrary color error is identified. The fix maps bg-[#3b82f6] to a semantic class like bg-primary.

assertions.name: fix-applied
assertions.check: File no longer contains bg-[#...] pattern
